svg.title: Timed medical pathway and the GPT embedding/prediction pipeline
svg.desc: Top panel: a patient's irregularly-timed clinical events on a time axis. Bottom panel: how tokenized events, time and patient features pass through embeddings and a causal transformer to produce contextual embeddings, then next-token and time-to-event predictions.
svg.text: A — a patient's timed medical pathway
unstructured + temporally irregular events → eᵢ tokens, tᵢ dates, fᵢ features
B — how the GPT produces embeddings and predictions
